study: Exact teacher variation discarded by a constant query/TrackID prediction
hypothesis: A constant score cannot reproduce teacher probabilities that differ between observations; the exact excess Bernoulli loss can be measured without target labels.
primary_measure: Uniform distinct-request Jensen entropy gap; decompose within requested anchor across views and between requested anchors.
controls: All four fixed policies and all six settings, plus CROP-only gap and fixed training clipping cost.
no_semantic_quality_claim: Teacher variation can be state information or teacher error. Policy-specific smaller gap is not necessarily better.
